description: This file defines classes and logic for IVR navigation using LLMs, including the IVRProcessor class that manages XML pattern matching and state transitions, and the IVRNavigator pipeline that orchestrates IVR and conversation modes with event hooks.

classes.name: IVRStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of IVR navigation status values (detected, completed, stuck, wait).

classes.name: IVRProcessor
classes.description: Processes LLM responses for IVR navigation commands, manages XML pattern matching for DTMF and IVR states, and triggers events accordingly.

classes.name: IVRNavigator
classes.description: Pipeline coordinating IVR and conversation modes using LLM service, handling context frames and providing event hooks for mode detection and IVR status updates.

methods.name: IVRStatus
methods.description: Enum members: DETECTED, COMPLETED, STUCK, WAIT.

methods.name: IVRProcessor.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the IVR processor, sets up XML pattern matching, and event registration.

methods.name: IVRProcessor.update_saved_messages
methods.description: Updates the saved context messages.

methods.name: IVRProcessor._get_conversation_history
methods.description: Returns the saved messages excluding the first system message.

methods.name: IVRProcessor._setup_xml_patterns
methods.description: Configures pattern matching for DTMF, mode, and IVR XML tags.

methods.name: IVRProcessor.process_frame
methods.description: Processes each frame, manages XML pattern matching, and triggers appropriate handlers.

methods.name: _handle_dtmf_action(self, match: PatternMatch)
methods.description: Handles DTMF commands by creating and pushing DTMF frames.

methods.name: _handle_ivr_action(self, match: PatternMatch)
methods.description: Handles IVR status updates, transitioning states and emitting events.

methods.name: _handle_mode_action(self, match: PatternMatch)
methods.description: Handles mode change commands (conversation or IVR).

methods.name: _handle_conversation(self)
methods.description: Triggers an event indicating conversation mode detection.

methods.name: _handle_ivr_detected(self)
methods.description: Switches system to IVR mode, with context updates and event emission.

methods.name: _handle_ivr_completed(self)
methods.description: Emits an event indicating IVR session completion.

methods.name: _handle_ivr_stuck(self)
methods.description: Emits an event indicating the IVR system is stuck.

methods.name: _handle_ivr_wait(self)
methods.description: Handles situations where more transcription is needed, no state change.

methods.name: IVRNavigator.__init__
methods.description: Initializes pipeline with LLM service and IVR processor, configures event hooks.

methods.name: IVRNavigator.process_frame
methods.description: Intercepts context frames to pass messages to the IVR processor for mode switching.

methods.name: IVRNavigator.add_event_handler
methods.description: Registers event handlers for detection and status change events.
